sections.overview: The Master in Strategic Marketing & Communication is a 10-month, full-time program designed to develop future marketing leaders at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and AI-powered decision-making. It provides a 360-degree exploration of the marketing and communication landscape, equipping students with skills in brand and reputation management, communication, and marketing. The program is for future-thinking professionals with a strategic business mindset who seek to lead organizations through strategic decisions and create business value.

Additional components include: Multimedia simulations and real-world challenges with companies like Google, Leo Burnett, and Diageo. Final consulting project generating real value for real companies. Optional certifications from digital leaders like Google and Salesforce. IE University Sustainability Certificate available. Optional international experiences including Global Immersion Week or Social Impact Week in London, Ghana, Amsterdam, or South Africa. sections.overview: The Master in Customer Experience & Innovation empowers you to create impactful, human-centered designs in product, service, and experience sectors. By rethinking and redesigning the customer journey, you'll enhance consumer interactions and drive substantial value for businesses. The program transforms you into a leader in innovation through exploration of product innovation and management, service and experience design, business and growth strategy, and innovation skills. Graduates pursue roles such as strategic designer, innovation manager, CX specialist, UX designer, product manager, and chief experience officer.

Learning outcomes include: designing impactful human-centered solutions; experience design, journey mapping, service redesign, and new value validation; creating seamless, synchronized experiences across all customer touchpoints; mastering leadership and design thinking; launching innovation in a global marketing ecosystem; developing insight generation, design thinking, prototyping, adaptive leadership, project management and human-centered innovation skills.

name: Master in Market Research & Consumer Behavior

sections.overview: The Master in Market Research & Consumer Behavior is an innovative 10-month program designed to delve into neuromarketing and consumer psychology, uncovering motivations behind consumer behaviors. It integrates business, marketing, data analytics, and consumer behavior studies to enable deep insights through quantitative and qualitative research. Graduates develop informed business strategies and actionable plans to meet and anticipate market demands, preparing for specialized careers as market researchers, insights managers, data scientists, and behavioral analysts.
sections.format: Duration: 10 months. Modality: In-person. Language: English (implied). Location: Madrid, Spain. Intake: September 7th, 2026 for 2026-2027 academic year. The program includes a Common Core Period with other marketing, communication and sales students, followed by specialized modules. Optional Global Immersion Week or Social Impact Week available, plus optional three-month Career Specialization extension.
sections.curriculum:
Common Core Period: foundational courses in business marketing & strategy, consumer insights & analytics, and consumer psychology & behavior, enhancing analytical, creative and digital capabilities.

Key areas covered: Consumer psychology and behavior, consumer insights, neuromarketing, business intelligence, AI-driven analytics, quantitative and qualitative market research methods (ethnography, surveys, analytics).

Electives: Third term offers choice between Data Analytics path or Consumer Behavior path.

Certifications: Optional Google, Salesforce, or IE University Sustainability Certificate.

Consulting Projects: Real-world challenges with companies like Nielsen, Millward Brown, and Telefónica.

International experiences: Global Immersion Week or Social Impact Week in locations such as London, Ghana, Amsterdam, and South Africa.

Learning outcomes: Decode consumer motivations through neuromarketing; develop expertise in consumer psychology and buyer behavior; craft business strategies as Consumer Insights Manager or Marketing Intelligence Strategist; apply research insights to real-world challenges; leverage insights for business growth.

Top employers include Nielsen, Kantar, Ipsos, Johnson & Johnson, P&G, WPP, Telefónica, Amazon, Visa, Nike, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Diageo, and the Financial Times. It shapes students into innovative experts who leverage data science and advanced analytics to drive business value and innovation. The program is designed for professionals with prior career success who want to expand their capabilities in business, data, and technology to fulfill their professional potential.

The dual degree includes a unique six-month MXT (Management Xponential Technology) program focused on Management, Xponential Thinking, and Technology, which provides exposure to top tech leaders, CEOs, and founders for mentorship and exposure to exponential growth opportunities. name: IMBA + Computer Science and Business Technology

sections.overview: This Dual Degree combines the International MBA with the Master in Computer Science and Business Technology, designed for tech-savvy professionals seeking to bridge technology and business leadership. Graduates develop unique expertise in both computer science and management, positioning them to lead technological innovation and drive business transformation across industries.

sections.curriculum: The program combines two official degree tracks: International MBA covering marketing, strategy, corporate finance, and operations; Master in Computer Science and Business Technology focusing on latest tools, trends, and technologies. Graduates develop expertise in AI, cloud, cybersecurity, quantum technologies, and software architecture. The MXT component (six months) focuses on Management, Xponential Thinking, and Technology, providing networking, mentorship, and exposure to tech leaders, CEOs, and founders. Learning outcomes include fluency in computer science and management languages, ability to design and implement advanced technological solutions, and readiness for senior strategist and technology leadership roles.
